reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Gate 3 triggered. BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json explicitly lists 'Input validation issues' as out of scope; the root cause of this finding is a missing validation that tokensAllocated != 0 in publishSaleResults(), which would be the direct fix. Additionally, the only permitted caller is the Legion trusted admin (onlyLegion modifier), meaning exploitation requires the trusted role to act maliciously or erroneously — this falls under 'Centralization risks', also explicitly out of scope.
